notes.title: Linux Camera Fix / Minor improvements!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Resolved: We have been informed that our Linux version crashes during the very first scenario. After thorough investigations and testing, we were finally able to identify the issue and fix it!

However, if you encounter anything else that appears to be specific to the Linux version, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@magnolia.games.
[*]Resolved: At some point, the game gets stuck after clicking 'End Turn'. We detected the issue and were able to fix it.
[*]Optimized the displaying of ToolTips
[/list]

notes.title: Demon Loop is launching
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s finally time to take on the Demon Loop! We’re so happy to finally tell you that Demon Loop has launched onto Steam Early Access! We’re also launching with a 25% discount for the next week, so now’s the best time to pick up the game :)

We’re so excited to bring you our strategy, deck building adventure, and have lots more content planned for Early Access before our 1.0 launch!

Take a look below for our planned roadmap for Early Access

[b]Early Access Roadmap
[/b]
[list]
[*] New areas and levels to uncover and explore
[*] Story improvements
[*] More cards to collect, new effects and more stats to improve!
[*] The ability to customise your character
[*] Weekly and monthly challenges
[/list]

For now, following us on X/Twitter or Discord is the best way to stay notified of any updates and game progress. Wishlisting also helps out more than you know!

Thank you for your support so far! :D

notes.title: Demon Loop - Official Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello from Magnolia Games! I’m Juergen, and I’m excited to announce the brand new game that we’ve been working on, Demon Loop!

Demon Loop is an adventure strategy game, inspired by Slay the Spire and Gloomhaven. I’m thrilled to be working with the legendary [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgamedesigner/11767/alexander-pfister/linkeditems/boardgamedesigner?pageid=1&sort=rank]Alexander Pfister[/url], who’s authored the board games Great Western Trail, Isle of Skye and Port Royal! Together, we’re combining the charm and strategic depths of an expert board game to the possibilities of a video game.

It’s still early days of development, but take a look at the reveal trailer!

[previewyoutube=Iyt6wGVeCZI;full]
[/previewyoutube]

There’s going to be plenty to do in Demon Loop, from expanding and upgrading your Loop hub, growing your deck of cards that you use to battle demons, and uncovering the larger story behind why monsters have turned on people.

The current plan is for Demon Loop to be released in Early Access towards the end of this year if all goes well, and develop the game alongside your feedback. There’s a long road of improvements and features planned!

For now, following us on [url=https://www.twitter.com/_magnoliagames]Twitter[/url] is the best way to stay notified of any updates and game progress. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439830/Demon_Loop]Wishlisting[/url] also helps out more than you know!

Thank you for your support, and I can’t wait to bring you more updates soon :D
